title: Minimum Wage of R$1,741 in 2027: Finance Ministry Proposal
seoTitle: Minimum Wage: R$1,741 in 2027, Says Finance Ministry
subtitle: The estimate announced by Minister Dario Durigan will be part of the Annual Budget Law Draft.
excerpt: The Finance Minister, Dario Durigan, announced on Monday (24) that the minimum wage is projected to reach R$1,741 in 2027, a figure that will be incorporated into the annual budget law draft.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The minimum wage in Brazil is expected to reach R$1,741 in 2027. The projection was announced on Monday (24) by Finance Minister Dario Durigan and represents a crucial data point for the country's economic planning in the coming years.

This estimate is not an isolated announcement; it will be formally incorporated into the Annual Budget Law Draft (PLOA). The PLOA is the document that details the government's planned revenues and expenditures for the next fiscal year. After its preparation, the draft will be forwarded to the National Congress, following the established timetable for Brazilian budget legislation, with a final submission deadline of August 31.

The minimum wage essentially serves as a wage floor for Brazilian workers. Its annual determination is a process with significant social and economic impact, directly influencing the purchasing power of millions of citizens and serving as a reference for various other income categories and social benefits. The projection of its value, therefore, is central to discussions about the country's economic policy.

The Annual Budget Law Draft (PLOA), where the minimum wage estimate will be inserted, is a key component of public administration. It sets the guidelines for the allocation of federal resources, defining priorities and allocating funds to different sectors and programs. The process of sending it to the National Congress marks the beginning of the legislative rite, where parliamentarians analyze, discuss, and may propose amendments to the original text before its voting and sanction.

The proposal for a minimum wage of R$1,741 in 2027, as announced by Minister Dario Durigan on Monday (24), anticipates one of the most awaited pieces of information each year. Including this value in the PLOA and its subsequent submission to the National Congress by August 31 are essential steps toward realizing this projection, which outlines important aspects of the Brazilian economy for the coming years.

With information from Agência Brasil.
